source: Environment (NASA OSDR Environmental Data App, Rodent Research-1, ISS 2014)
note: Station measurements, not any crew member's personal exposure.
assumptions: CO2 converted from ppm with a cabin pressure of 760 mmHg (14.7 psia).
method: Each day's average compared with the previous 7 days (median and robust spread); 3 or more spreads away is 'unusual for this cabin'. Limit lines come from NASA-STD-3001.

evaluation.note: Flagged real days are not all false alarms: some are real changes in the cabin.

unusual: CO2 2.32 mmHg is 3.1 spreads above this cabin's usual of 2.01 mmHg (previous 7 days)
CO2 2.88 mmHg is 3.5 spreads above this cabin's usual of 2.53 mmHg (previous 7 days)
